task: Review all ten StudioOpticsUITests workflow method accounting and meaningful assertions for transform/undo/selection, plus required shard mapping; read-only source review.

observations.detail: Exactly ten unique XCTest entrypoints exist: testOpticsEditingUndoRedoAndRelaunch and testOpticsRepeatability02 through testOpticsRepeatability10. Each calls the same runOpticsEditingUndoRedoAndRelaunch helper. These are ten repetitions of one workflow, as the repeatability names indicate.

Meaningful assertions require one native width slider, its Width in meters label and 0.6 m initial readout, an actual changed width and enabled Undo, restoration of the prior width while preserving Rectangular softbox kind, enabled Redo and restoration of edited width, a completed save before termination, and persisted kind/width after relaunch. Fresh test IDs isolate runs; the same app launch environment is retained for relaunch.

Coverage boundary: these ten workflows do not manipulate spatial transforms or explicitly assert selected-light identity. Their selection assertion concerns emitter kind. This is not by itself a demonstrated acceptance defect because the contract separately requires room/precision/studio workflows; no claim that these ten establish all transform/selection coverage is warranted.

StudioOpticsUITests belongs exactly once to the required studio-optics shard and to no diagnostic shard. The CI matrix includes that shard; source inventory produces ten expected methods, with log verification requiring exactly one ordered started then passed sequence for every method.
